notes.title: Update v1.10 now live!
notes.content:
Hey everyone, back with a quick update for HellStar that adds some general improvements and some new features!

Changelog:
- Changed player movement physics (no more inertia!)
- The addition of Normal, Hard and Veteran difficulty settings
- New boss rush mode (unlock by beating the game)
- More achievements
- V-Sync option added

Hope you all enjoy the new content and thank you to everyone who has played the game so far and supported it! 

Extra congrats to those who have beat it ;)

Cheers, 
CosmicCrystal

notes.title: Update v1.01 is now live!
notes.content:
///HellStar Squadron Update v1.01 
Changelog:
* Hitbox size fix
* Hitbox indicator now visible when using beam weapon
* Dialogue speed increase and dialogue skip option added
* Bomb collision fix + bombs now clear bullets
* Difficulty tweaking to reduce dead air
* Achievements fix
* Main Menu/Stage 8 music bug fixed
* Fullscreen 'black screen' bug fix
